title: Cluster Sentinel quick-ops deck and upgrade friction mapper
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, actionable ops surface (Cluster Sentinel) that lives on the Private Console cluster overview and an adjacent explorer called the Upgrade Friction Mapper. Goals: surface immediate mitigations as 'quick-ops cards' for on-call and tenant owners, show a friction heatmap for planned upgrades (network, kernel, driver, control plane), and present projected cost/latency delta for optional rollback or canary strategies. Deliver a prototype flow for canary scheduling, automated rollback triggers, and a compact cost preview card tied to tenant billing buckets.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype (Figma) of Cluster Sentinel card rail integrated into the cluster overview page
Upgrade Friction Mapper that visualizes per-tenant friction score and top 3 drivers for friction
Interaction flows for canary rollout creation and a reversible rollback action visible on each card
Cost delta preview panel that calculates estimated token/GPU spend impact for upgrade strategies
Design spec doc with accessibility checks and responsive behavior for 1280px -> 1440px -> 1920px
Handoff-ready redlines and component list for implementation (React + Chakra tokens)
decisions: Use a compact rail of prioritized quick-ops cards instead of a full-page incident list to keep the cluster overview uncluttered.

Friction score will be computed on the backend (composite of network latency risk, config drift, & tenant-specific blockers) and surfaced as three-tier badge (Low / Moderate / High) with details on hover.
Cost preview will default to a 24-hour delta and allow expanding to 7/30-day simulated views.
Rollback CTA will open a guarded modal requiring two-step confirmation and will include a reason dropdown for audit logs.
tradeoffs: Compact cards reduce scan time but hide some context; we provide a quick 'peek' flyout to show last 3 events to mitigate missing context.
Showing cost deltas increases cognitive load; to manage this we default to conservative estimates and a clear tooltip explaining assumptions.
Calculating friction on the fly is expensive; we will cache scores for 2 minutes and show a refresh action.
implementation_notes: Component tokens: use existing alert-card, small-badge, and inline-sparkline primitives from the design system.
Backend API: /v1/private/cluster/{id}/sentinel and /v1/private/upgrade-friction?range=24h (engineering to implement scoring).
Telemetry: add events for quick-ops CTA clicks, canary creation, rollback confirmations, and cost-preview expands.
Security: rollback action requires RBAC check (tenant-ops role) and will surface required approvals if missing.
